request: Make an iMessage video about two friends getting concert tickets.

motion_choices.seed_reason: Browse pictures inside a place or album surface with persistent labels. Use the separate UI adapter variant for inline conversation paging.

seed.title: Slide the photos beneath a fixed heading
seed.moves: Adjacent photos translate together on one horizontally clipped rail.
seed.fixed: The heading, viewport, divider and supporting footer stay in place.
seed.notice: The next photo comes into view while the place and surrounding context remain easy to read.
seed.fits: Browse pictures inside a place or album surface with persistent labels. Use the separate UI adapter variant for inline conversation paging.
seed.avoid: A stack that lifts or dismisses only its front photo needs independent layers and depth.
intents: Move the photos beneath a fixed heading
Slide pictures horizontally under a title that stays put
Keep the shop name pinned as the storefront photos glide past
Scroll images without moving the header
Browse ticket options on a card rail while the event name stays visible

editableFields.heading: text
editableFields.photos: array of local PNG, JPEG or WebP paths, relative to the content JSON
editableFields.message: optional stationary message beneath the photo rail

source.note: Normalized Linq rail shift sampled by the earlier motion library at a23bfb2. Reproduced at a new size with authored artwork and a held header.

seed.title: Separate a ticket along its perforation
seed.moves: A perforated seam parts left to right as the stub tilts around the still-joined edge, then drops once detached.
seed.fixed: The main ticket, its copy and the backdrop stay pinned.
seed.notice: The smaller section belonged to the original ticket and is now independently usable.
seed.fits: Show a detachable stub or one part becoming independent after separation.
seed.avoid: An ordinary close action has no physical seam, and a stack reveal keeps its surfaces intact.
intents: Tear the receipt stub off along the perforated line
Detach the bottom of a ticket while the top stays pinned

seed.title: Reveal actions around a pressed message
seed.moves: Context dims while the option tray opens below the held row and the reaction rail grows above it.
seed.fixed: The selected message stays centered on its original slot throughout the reveal.
seed.notice: The press selects one message and exposes possible actions.
seed.fits: Introduce options tied to a single message without implying a choice has happened.
seed.avoid: A held menu should not imply a reaction was picked, content was deleted, or the full conversation changed.
intents: Long press one message and show the reaction choices
Open the menu around a bubble without moving it
Dim the chat around one selected message

source.note: Recorded window covers the selected row, dimming, menu and bar entrance. The source calibration gives a 380 ms menu entrance. Preview artwork, blur treatment and control labels are adapted.
